    if spoofRegistry[instance] and spoofRegistry[instance][prop] then

        instance[prop] = entry.Real
        spoofRegistry[instance][prop] = nil

-- Remove all spoofs for an instance

    if spoofRegistry[instance] then
        for prop, entry in pairs(spoofRegistry[instance]) do

        end
        spoofRegistry[instance] = nil
    end
end

function Stealth.updateFake(instance, prop, fakeValue)
    if spoofRegistry[instance] and spoofRegistry[instance][prop] then
        spoofRegistry[instance][prop].Fake = fakeValue
        instance[prop] = fakeValue
    end
end

    return spoofRegistry[instance] and spoofRegistry[instance][prop] ~= nil
